verdict.rationale: Speechmatics is API-first. Transcription (batch, realtime, Agent STT), TTS and the analysis features are all exposed via API and SDKs, and management tokens create projects and manage API keys programmatically (docs-18). The web platform also handles billing, user invites and roles, and voice-agent building (docs-9, docs-22), and the evidence never confirms those are API-accessible or claims full UI/API parity; the OpenAPI probe also found no published spec. missing for 10: explicit UI/API parity statement, API evidence for billing, user/role management and voice-agent building, a published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.
